title: Lester Young's dice games on the Basie bus
summary: Pres started crap games on the crowded bus and was always first broke.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: He would start a crap game. Be the first one to start a crap game on the bus and he'd be the first one to go to sleep, being broke. Be the first one to go to sleep. Everybody would be on the bus, you know, we had an old bus. At that time we carried everything on top of the bus, you know. They had the

rack. We had everything. Oh, the bus would be loaded down with bags and everything. And the bus would be so -- the seats were so -- we were so short of space until we'd have to take turns sitting on the outside so you could stretch your legs in the aisles, you know.

So we'd go on to sleep and he would wake up, take the dice and shake them in everybody's ear -- go all around the bus, say "Sweet Music, Sweet Music, Sweet Music." Start a crap game, he'd be the first one broke. All the time. Be the first one broke.
Such a -- oh, my goodness, he was such a classic.
